title: Linked List Components
summary: Given a linked list with unique integers and an array of integers, determine the count of maximal sequences of consecutive nodes where each node's value is in the array.
statement: Given a linked list with unique integers and an array of integers, determine the count of maximal sequences of consecutive nodes where each node's value is in the array.
constraints: The list contains unique integers and nums is a subset of its values.
A component is a maximal consecutive run of nodes whose values belong to nums.
hints: Track whether the previous node was inside the selected set.
A new component begins exactly at a selected node following the list start or an unselected node.
Scan once with set membership and an inside flag.
Every maximal selected run has exactly one such first node.
editorial: Every maximal selected run has exactly one such first node.

tests.explanation: Nodes zero-one form one component and node three forms another.
Membership runs zero-one and three-four produce two components.
